summary: Tested backend and frontend on the real tenant c5ae2d0e. The requested account qa.tester@schiantarelli.it does NOT exist in the preview DB (login returns 401, no row in users), so all tests ran as jacopo@schiantarelli.it, the admin of the same tenant listed in test_credentials.md. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass. Covered: trattative CRUD with checklist and premio_proposto, toggling a checklist item, per-column valore on /pipeline/trattative before and after a move, /invia returning 400 for a missing recipient (email and whatsapp) and for an invalid canale, /invia returning 404, whatsapp-chat with the numero param (including the +39 format), diario document download (Bearer and cookie-only) and storage ?token= (200 with token, 401 without). Frontend passes: typeable client search, create/reopen persistence of checklist and premio, checklist toggle persistence, Email/WhatsApp send controls render, invia email shows the 400 toast, empty gates plus 'Popola automaticamente' on polizze/sinistri/titoli/regolazione/clienti, trattative not gated, polizze populated after confirm, Diario 'Apri chat' loads the real WA conversation, diario PDF link shows '(240 KB)' with no NaN and fetches 200 application/pdf 245833 bytes, logo and avatar include ?token= and render. Two bugs found: (1) the kanban column totals do NOT update after a drag-move until a page reload; (2) the trattativa client search only covers the first 2000 of 5627 clients.

minor.issue: The 'Canale non valido' check runs after find_one and enrich, so an invalid canale on a nonexistent id returns 404 instead of 400. Cosmetic.

WhatsApp media enrichment runs one whatsapp_messages query per diario row (N+1) and attaches ALL media of that number to EVERY whatsapp row of the client, so the same files repeat on each row. The endpoint is also slow: about 5-8s per call on the real tenant (13 tests took 102s, mostly diario calls).

ui_bugs.component: Pipeline > Trattative kanban (Pipeline.jsx onDrop optimistic update ~line 163)
ui_bugs.issue: After dragging a deal to another column, the backend updates stato correctly (verified in DB), but the column header totals col-valore-{key} and riepilogo-valore-aperte/vinte stay stale. Only cards and count are updated optimistically; valore and riepilogo are not recalculated and load() is not called on success. Reproduced: dragged a 777€ deal from Vinte to Aperte, and the headers still showed Aperte €0 / Vinte €777 until reload. Fix: recompute valore in the optimistic update (needs the card's premio) or call load() after a successful move.

The dialog loads only /anagrafiche?limit=2000 and filters client-side. The real tenant has 5627 anagrafiche, so 3627 clients (64%) cannot be found by typing. Verified: searching 'EMMECI LOGISTICA' returns 0 options, but the client exists. Fix: server-side search (/anagrafiche?q=...) with debounce, or remove the limit. Related: the list is also cut with .slice(0,100), so in edit mode a selected client outside the filtered list may show a blank trigger.

integration_issues.issue: There is no confirmation step: one click sends a REAL email or WhatsApp to the customer, with no preview of the recipient or message. It also sends the last SAVED state, not unsaved form edits. Recommend a confirm dialog showing destinatario and the message text.

issues: 'Scadenza polizza concorrente' uses the native browser date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar/DatePicker, and the US format is inconsistent with the Italian UI
The 'Risparmio' column shows a negative red value (e.g. -777€) when premio_corrente is 0; it should show '—' when no current premium exists
The delete button in the trattative table has no data-testid

Board activation is stored in localStorage (pipeline_attiva_{entita}), so it is per-browser, not per-user or per-tenant: a different user on the same browser inherits it, and the same user sees an empty board on a new device

action_items: Pipeline.jsx: after a successful drag/move, recompute col.valore and riepilogo (or call load()) so the per-column premium totals update immediately

Trattative.jsx: replace the /anagrafiche?limit=2000 client-side filter with a server-side typeahead (q param) so all 5600+ clients are searchable; make sure the selected client in edit mode always renders
Add a confirmation dialog (recipient + message preview) before the real Email/WhatsApp send from a trattativa
Create the qa.tester@schiantarelli.it user in the preview DB, or fix test_credentials.md: the account does not exist (login 401)
Optional: diario whatsapp media N+1 and duplicate files on every WA row; replace the native date input with the shadcn date picker
critical_code_review_comments: auth.get_token_from_request now accepts ?token= for EVERY endpoint, not only storage/download. A full-privilege JWT in the URL leaks into proxy/access logs, browser history and Referer headers. Restrict the query-param fallback to /api/storage/* and the download routes, or use short-lived signed URLs.
imgUrl reads localStorage 'token'. If the login uses httpOnly cookies, also keeping the JWT in localStorage removes the XSS protection of httpOnly.
server.py is over 20k lines and AnagraficaDetail.jsx is 2752 lines; both should be split.
invia_preventivo calls the blocking smtplib _invia_email inside an async route, which blocks the event loop during SMTP I/O. Use run_in_threadpool or asyncio.to_thread.
Diario documents use <a href target=_blank> and depend on the access_token cookie (works: 200 with cookie, 401 without).

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (2 bugs: stale kanban totals after move; client search limited to 2000)

No real email or WhatsApp was sent: invia was only called on 'TEST CATENA' (1694b6b8, no email or cellulare) and returned 400. Clicking 'Popola automaticamente' on polizze only sets localStorage; no data changed.

The tenant has no WA media, email attachments or pdf_storage_path diario rows, so those document sources were NOT tested end-to-end (only manual allegati). Client beyond the 2000 limit: 'EMMECI LOGISTICA SRL'. Pipeline remembers the last tab; click pipeline-tab-trattative explicitly.
rca of the issue: Kanban totals: Pipeline.jsx onDrop optimistically moves cards and adjusts count, but col.valore/riepilogo come only from the server response of GET /pipeline/trattative, which is re-fetched only on error. Client search: Trattative.jsx fetches /anagrafiche?limit=2000 and filters locally, so records after 2000 are never loaded.
